description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join a small, high-ownership product team at an early-stage B2B SaaS startup as a backend-leaning product engineer. You'll own customer-facing features end-to-end, navigate messy integrations and legacy systems, and make product and engineering trade-offs with speed and strong judgment. This is a role for someone who thrives in ambiguity, moves fast, and cares deeply about shipping real products that customers use.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own features end-to-end — from design through shipping and iteration — with minimal PM oversight.

 - Build and maintain backend systems, APIs, data models, and automation pipelines.

 - Integrate with external tools, legacy systems, and third-party services.

 - Design workflows and orchestration for AI/automation-driven product features.

 - Debug production issues and exercise strong engineering judgment under pressure.

 - Collaborate closely with founders, customers, and cross-functional stakeholders in a hybrid San Francisco setting.

 - Balance full-stack work when required, with a clear emphasis on backend ownership.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Required:

 - Backend-focused software engineering with hands-on experience designing, implementing, and shipping customer-facing features.

 - Demonstrated ownership of the full feature lifecycle — ideation, implementation, and iteration based on customer feedback.

 - Track record of shipping real products, ideally in 0-to-1 or ambiguous, fast-moving environments.

 - Strong cross-functional collaboration and communication skills.

 - Must be legally eligible to work in the US without employer sponsorship.

 - Based in San Francisco or willing to relocate; hybrid/in-office presence required.

Nice to Have:

 - Experience with applied AI, agentic workflows, RAG pipelines, or LLM-enabled features.

 - Python proficiency (modern web/backend stacks considered — engineering quality matters more than specific stack).

 - Systems integration experience with external APIs and legacy platforms.

 - Early-stage startup experience or founding engineer background.

Not a fit if you are: frontend-only, data/internal-tools-only, pure DevOps/SRE without product ownership, pure research ML without shipping experience, or primarily motivated by corporate titles.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

 - Base salary: up to $275,000 depending on experience.

 - Equity: meaningful equity package.

 - No visa sponsorship available.


LOCATION

San Francisco, CA — hybrid/on-site. Candidates must be based in SF or willing to relocate.
